'''Pickled potatoes''' are pickled [[Baked Potato|baked potato]]es. They heal {{Value|Pickled Potatoes|heals}}, the most of any preserve, and have no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_potatoes.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A baked potato, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. Obtaining a baked potato unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pickled potatoes takes {{Value|Pickled Potatoes|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Pickled Potatoes|heals}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Pickled potatoes no longer give Resistance.}}
}}
